title: Sidebar: a bot's name wraps only between words; Needs you is a compact hand
body:
Oleks's report, the part #290 didn't cover: "Researcher" next to the "Needs you" pill broke inside the word ("Researche / r"), hovered or not. At a narrower sidebar with the lead tag it went down to one letter per line.

**Cause.** `data-bot-name` had `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`. The `shrink-0` pill, lead tag and approvals badge squeezed it to about 100 px, so the browser broke inside words.

**Change** (`frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`)
- The name wraps only between words or after a hyphen, on up to 2 lines (`[overflow-wrap:normal] [word-break:normal] line-clamp-2 text-ellipsis`). A word too long for the line ends in "…". The full name stays in the title tooltip.
- On the name line, the "Needs you" pill is now compact: the amber hand, plus "2", "3"… past one. It keeps the amber pill look, with `aria-label`/`title` "<name> needs you in the browser".
- The status line under the name says "Needs you in the browser" in amber while a step is open. If the line already says "Needs you in the browser in <chat>", that text is kept.
- #290 N1: on desktop, a bot with no title keeps a one-line status line, so Edit and Remove never sit on a 2-line name.
- Unchanged from #290: hovering or focusing never changes a row's height or moves the name line.

**Tests**
- New `frontend/tests/nameWrap.test.mjs` (6 tests, desktop and phone). It fails if any mid-word break class (`overflow-wrap:anywhere/break-word`, `break-all`, `break-words`, `hyphens-auto`) returns. It also covers the compact pill and its label, the status line, and the empty-title reserve. All 6 fail on main and pass here.
- `ia.test.mjs` QA a now asserts the opposite of the old `overflow-wrap:anywhere`.
- `npm test`: 1296 pass, 0 fail. `tsc --noEmit` is clean.

**Real-browser check.** Production builds of main and this branch, against a throwaway kwnt (1b581a9 image binary), in Chromium. Widths 1440, 1024 and 768, sidebar at the default 256 px and narrowed to 230 px with CSS, plus a 390 px phone. Names: Researcher, "Booktun.ing Marketer", "Low content book trending and low competetive idea finder", a 30-letter word, and hyphenated versions. Cases: Needs you ×1 and ×2, lead plus Needs you, approvals badge plus Needs you, and an untitled bot, each hovered and focused. That is 28 cases and 210 rows:
- main: 82 rows break mid-word, and the pencil covers the untitled bot's 2-line name in 3.
- this branch: 0 and 0.

Screenshots and note: `/home/maus/shared/ship-software-safely/row-wrap/`.

Not checked: Safari/WebKit (Chromium only).
